title: “Corruption isn’t political. It’s moral.”
paragraphs: Hindi na ‘to bago. Taon-taon may baha, taon-taon may pondo, pero taon-taon may nawawala. And the ones who suffer? Yung walang boses. I’m not here to defend any politician or attack any pangalan—ang tinuturo ko, sistema. When money meant to protect lives disappears, that’s not just corruption, that’s moral failure. As believers, we don’t clap for scandals, we grieve for injustice. We speak truth without hate, we demand accountability without becoming cruel, and we refuse to let our righteous anger be used to divide us. Sabi ng Kasulatan, righteousness exalts a nation—but corruption slowly kills it. Lord, teach us to see clearly, speak wisely, and stand firm.
